items.title: 68514_Horace Henderson oral history interview
items.q: I had personnel with me like Ray Nance... He was that loyal to the group... we finally talked Ray into going [to join Duke].

ctx.x: Is this when the so-called Chicago style was really getting itself together with --
This was when I had the pleasure of playing the 400 Club when I had personnel with me like Ray
Nance -- Ray Nance just before he joined Duke. I was playing the 5100 Club, and one of the performers that was on that show was the great Danny Thomas.
